name: Calpine

source.quote: Significant Transactions and Developments Acquisition of Calpine Corporation On January 7, 2026, we acquired 100% of the outstanding equity of Calpine for a purchase price of approximately $22 billion.

description: Large U.S. natural gas and geothermal power producer, acquired by Constellation in January 2026.
explain: Calpine's gas fleet and Geysers geothermal plants became part of Constellation in a deal valued at about $22B at closing, making Constellation the largest U.S. power producer.
